title: Exclude the six-point rank-four length-30 sojourn (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. A universal closed eight-source binary singleton word of length 30 cannot have a multiplicity-two source whose rank-four sojourn visits exactly six projected states.

```diff
- PR #7093 leaves the size-six layer separate, with candidate layer sizes (24,6)
+ the six-point layer needs at least 32 complementary states, hence at least 38 slots
```

This closes the explicitly separate size-six opening in unpaidmoon #7093 at `94b36d4649b5d29829959409acbc1906ef0b4379`. Three translates can cover an elementary binary group only if the other set has at least half the group. Applying that affine-plane coset argument in each of eight fibers gives the new obstruction. An explicit 32+6 cross-layer cover attains this set-cover bound, but fails the same-layer condition and is not a universal word.

The contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit unpaidmoon #7093/#7015/#6943 for the question and sojourn split, RossRichardson #943 for the singleton prefix model, and Mister-Meeseeks #1185, conorholds #3058, petalas #5234 and NicholasStone #5430 for the retained eight-source lineage. The abstract counting method is elementary; no literature-wide priority claim is made. Predecessor scientific executables were cited, not replayed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19592097). The connector-alphabet-change card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result within the existing alphabet.

## Evidence

Before, #7093 leaves the six-point case outside its sixteen-point census. The new self-contained proof excludes it without using that census, the rank-three exclusions or f(7)=24.

Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized replay passed all 4,484,480 pairs of 8,008 six-sets and 560 triples in F_2^4. No pair covers the group. A separate literal-set implementation checks all 8,008 normalized cases; their cardinality histogram agrees with the complete census. The explicit cross-layer cover, its failed same-layer condition and four boundary controls pass. Four disposable implementation mutations were rejected.

Every registered command was timed locally at about 0.33 to 0.35 seconds. Metadata/source pins, registered replay, exact six-file committed bytes and source history pass at `68c3c7dd16fe87d86386d7dc61ae566c552925cc`. Official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized execution pass with identical generated package-hash receipts.

From the repository root, using the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -B research/rank4-six-point-sojourn/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -I -O -B research/rank4-six-point-sojourn/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank4-six-point-sojourn
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank4-six-point-sojourn --check-source-history
```

Expected marker: `PASS_RANK4_SIX_POINT_SOJOURN`, with `paired_sumsets=4484480`, `complementary_layer_floor=32` and `cross_layer_total_floor=38`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This does not decide the remaining layer sizes, construct or exclude every length-30 word, or improve f(8) or kappa. A cross-layer set cover is not a legal chronological word or a complete difference cover. Physical query prices, routing, restoration, native/stock/precision/caller admission and a complete multiplication theorem remain outside scope. No predecessor scientific replay, Lean, Docker or selected cold replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Does a universal length-30 word survive the remaining rank-four sizes and higher-rank cases? First search a rank-four layer with 17 complementary points under #7093's existing constraints, excluding size six by this proof. The coupled same-layer cover and legal closed walk remain blockers. This contribution stops at the new exclusion.

## Related open work

- #7093: direct question source; its sixteen-point rank-four exclusion leaves the size-six boundary that this proof closes. Its census is not replayed.
- #7015: excludes rank-three length-30 sojourns and leaves rank at least four open. This result concerns one rank-four size only.
- #7088: constrains rank pairs of length-28 double-source arcs. A different word length; its flat-step counts are not recomputed.
- #7300: counts placements of the two double sources at length 28. This proof studies a six-point projected layer at length 30 and supplies no placement count.
- #7302: gives a length-28 all-ones case-II body-sumset obligation. This proof uses a different cross-layer condition and does not decide that obligation.
- #7321: bounds adjacent-pair diversity at length 28. Its degree argument is neither used nor extended here.
- #7448: constrains source counts in a distance-10 all-ones arc at length 28. This proof does not classify all-ones arcs.

No extra computation was run to validate or compare these predecessors' numbers. Searches include live open PRs, recent account PR bodies, handoff claims, targeted all-state and merged searches, and canonical-main README terms. The cached overlap helper reports sparse local coverage and no remote snapshot; no match is not a novelty certificate.

The related-work list above remains current for that check.
